summary: Assess payment fraud exposure, design controls, and practise monitoring and case escalation. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Digital payment fraud risk work helps payment operations, risk, compliance and investigation professionals assess exposure and shape proportionate controls. They map card, wallet and account journeys, assess merchant and agent risks, review transaction alerts, and document case findings and escalation. The course introduces AI-assisted anomaly detection at an operational awareness level, with practice focused on risk and case artefacts rather than model development.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, monitor, investigate, or oversee fraud exposure in digital payment operations.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with payment operations, financial services risk, compliance, audit, or fraud investigation is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop if you plan to complete spreadsheet-based exercises digitally; no specific software installation is required.
